test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question: How do the actors of Blind Opera ascertain they are on stage?

options.text: By the ropes used to demarcate the area
By their familiarity with the stage
By the cheering of the audience
By their sense of smell and touch

solution:
​The correct answer is "**By the ropes used to demarcate the area**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **theme **of the comprehension passage is about blind opera, challenges overcome by blind opera members to impress the audience, and the purpose to reach the larger community of people with blindness who live in isolation. They want to establish a drama school that caters to all those who are economically and socially forced to stay on the periphery.
 
• In the **second **paragraph of the comprehension, it is stated that the directors use ropes to separate the stage and the wings. When the actors step on the rope they know that it is the entrance to the stage.

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1**
